hero.title: Seamless cryptocurrency solutions, built to scale.
hero.subtitle: AdCrypto redefines the cryptocurrency experience — a comprehensive platform tailored for entrepreneurs and businesses entering the dynamic world of digital assets.

howItWorks.subtitle: A comprehensive solution for anyone venturing into the dynamic world of digital assets — set up once, then buy, trade and settle with confidence.

onboarding.title: User-Friendly Onboarding
onboarding.body: Provide your details, clear authentication once, and step into a dashboard that gives a holistic view of your crypto world.

transactions.title: Cryptocurrency Transactions
transactions.body: Trade securely with the parameters that fit your needs — exchanging, buying or selling, with fees shown before you confirm.

secure.title: Connect and Secure
secure.body: Hassle-free withdrawals and peer-to-peer transfers, protected by insured custody and 2FA on every action.

home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to manage crypto
home.featuresSubtitle: Core features built into every AdCrypto account.

multiWallet.title: Multiple Cryptocurrency Wallet
multiWallet.text: Manage multiple cryptocurrency wallets in one place, enabling efficient handling of different coins and assets.

buyInside.title: Buy Crypto Inside Wallet
buyInside.text: Purchase crypto directly into your internal wallet by selecting the coin and network and entering your payment details.

buyOutside.title: Buy Crypto Outside Wallet
buyOutside.text: Buy cryptocurrency for external wallets by choosing the coin, network, and entering the destination crypto address.

sellInside.title: Sell Crypto Inside Wallet
sellInside.text: Quickly sell crypto within your internal wallet by selecting coin details and confirming the payment method.

sellOutside.title: Sell Crypto Outside Wallet
sellOutside.text: Sell crypto to external wallets by specifying the coin, network, and entering the external wallet address.

withdraw.title: Withdraw Crypto
withdraw.text: Withdraw funds securely to external wallets by entering the amount and verifying your wallet address.

exchange.title: Exchange Crypto
exchange.text: Swap between different cryptocurrencies in your wallet, managing transfers efficiently in one place.

pushNotification.title: Push Notification
pushNotification.text: Stay updated with real-time push notifications about transactions, payments and account activity.

emailVerification.title: Email Verification
emailVerification.text: Enhance security by verifying your email to confirm your identity and protect your account.

kyc.title: KYC Verification
kyc.text: Complete KYC verification to ensure account security and compliance with regulatory requirements.

twoFa.title: 2FA Security
twoFa.text: Enable two-factor authentication to add an extra layer of security to your account access.

about.title: Built for people who want control of their crypto
about.intro: AdCrypto is a crypto wallet and exchange platform that lets people buy, sell, hold and move digital assets safely from a single dashboard.
about.missionText: Make managing multiple cryptocurrencies as simple as using a regular banking app, without giving up security or control over your funds.
about.visionText: A single trusted place to hold every coin you own, move it anywhere, and prove who you are only once.

security.title: Security first
security.text: KYC, 2FA and email verification are built in from day one, not bolted on later.

simplicity.title: Simple by default
simplicity.text: Buying, selling and exchanging crypto should take a few taps, not a manual.

transparency.title: Transparent activity
transparency.text: Every transaction is logged and visible to you, in real time.
